title: Module inventory
description: What runs on a site, by kind, for the module loader's two-way check (ADR-0027, proposed; docs/modules.md, 'What the loader checks'): every running name bound to a module id (<id> or <id>-..., a table as table:<id_>.<name>) must be declared by that module, which the site selects, and every declared name must run. A name bound to no module id is the core's and is not judged by this check. The deployer writes it from the hosts (unit names without the hnx- prefix and the .service/.timer suffix, service rows by registry name, MCP server ids, agent keys, lake tables). Optionally, the running notifier's recovery pairs (notify_pairs), each with the module it is bound to; a pair with no module is the core's. Without notify_pairs the pairs are not compared, and the loader says so. The rules are in homelabnext.modules.loader.running_problems.

units.description: Fleet unit names that are installed and enabled.

rows.description: Service rows that answer: a feature's or core module's by row name, a provider's by the instance the site names.

mcp_servers.description: MCP server ids that are registered.

agents.description: Agent keys that have a compiled profile and a lane.

problem.description: The problem title the notifier holds.

module.description: The module the pair was loaded from; absent for a pair of the core's.

notify_pairs.description: The running notifier's recovery pairs (optional): each declared by its module, which the site selects, with the same recovery title, and every selected module's pair running.
